text:
rachel-support: FYI Brightline just escalated — after last night's region rollout their 'briefing' prompt in ap-sg returns completely off-topic paragraphs (mentions competitors, wrong dates). They say it only happens when routed to the singapore cluster. Provided 2 request ids: bl-3aa7, bl-3aa8. @tom-runtime @priya-ml

 tom-runtime: thanks. can you attach one minimal repro and the full response headers? also any latency or 5xx observed?

 rachel-support: minimal repro (customer redacted token):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Region: ap-southeast-1" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"input":"Briefing: Summarize the project status and risks for Q2 in 4 bullets."}' \\  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Observed behavior: expected 4 bullets about milestones, blockers, schedule. Actual: two paragraphs about a different product line and a fake conference date. No 5xxs. Latency slightly higher (~340ms vs 220ms in us-west). Response headers for bl-3aa7: `x-request-id: bl-3aa7`, `x-inference-path: int8-fused-sg-v3`, `x-model-version: redwood-1.7.2`

priya-ml: model/version consistent globally? quantization matrix or kernel selection different by hw?

 tom-runtime: deploy logs show runtime v3.14 rolled to ap-sg 2026-01-18T01:04Z (canary in us-east succeeded). ap-sg uses T4 profile with CUDA 520 and the new int8-fused path enabled; other regions on A100/H100 using fp16.

 yuki-ops: deploy-bot confirms: deploy completed: runtime v3.14 -> inference-engine v3.14 rolled to ap-sg at 2026-01-18T01:04Z (canary us-east).

 deploy-bot: deploy completed: inference-engine v3.14 -> ap-southeast-1 (job id jb-1b2c3d).

 priya-ml: this smells like a numerical drift in int8 path. can we capture logits or token-level probs for same prompt across ap-sg and us-west? alex (not in channel) had a helper script to diff token distributions.

 tom-runtime: rachel can you reproduce via our integration account forcing X-Region and grab x-request-id from response? also enable verbose logs on debug pool.

 rachel-support: reproduced with our integration key. x-request-id=bl-3aa7. When forced to us-west we see `x-inference-path: fp16-default` and output matches expected. When forced to ap-sg we see `x-inference-path: int8-fused-sg-v3`.

 priya-ml: started batch comparison (1k prompts) to compute delta. initial signals: hallucination rate +22% on int8-fused-sg-v3 vs fp16-default for briefing/summarization intents; token alignment appears to shift at block boundaries for seq_len>96. exporting diffs to gs://redwood-debug/ap-sg/int8-diffs/bl-3aa7.tar.gz

 yuki-ops: created debug pool (6 T4 nodes) with TRACE_LOG=1 and kernel debug turned on. sample trace:
```
[2026-01-18T02:20:13Z] request bl-3aa7 path=int8-fused-sg-v3 gpu=T4 driver=520 quant=INT8 seq_len=112
[2026-01-18T02:20:13Z] attention_tile_idx=3 pad_align=8 tile_mismatch=true
[2026-01-18T02:20:13Z] output_sample token="Confab" prob=0.042
```

 priya-ml: tile_mismatch=true is consistent with an earlier kernel bug where padding alignment on 8-byte boundaries caused wrong accumulators for some tiles. looks like for certain vocab tokens accumulation error nudges probability mass toward unrelated tokens.

 sre-oncall: opening incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-102 (link). paging kernel vendor and quant team. setting severity P2 pending customer confirmation.

 tom-runtime: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of ap-sg to v3.13 (pre-int8-fused change) 2) router rule to avoid int8 path for /generate routes tagged as "briefing" 3) per-customer header allowing fallback to fp16 nodes. Which is fastest?

 yuki-ops: rollback is simplest. can stage rollback for ap-sg now; ETA 10-15m. but we should first add a temporary router override for Brightline to avoid disruption during rollback window.

 rachel-support: Brightline is ok with temporary rollback if we notify. they asked about billing impact and whether retries happened. no billing anomaly reported.

 deploy-bot: rollback job started: inference-engine v3.13 -> ap-southeast-1, job id jb-7e6f5g.

 priya-ml: running a focused A/B on the debug pool: int8-fused-sg-v3 shows systematic probability shifts at tile boundaries; aggregated KL divergence vs fp16-default is high for tokens at positions 96-112. filing kernel bug ticket with vendor: KB-8342, attaching traces and diffs.

 yuki-ops: rollback complete for ap-sg to v3.13. monitoring customer signals. quick smoke-check with Brightline: their briefings look normal now.

 sre-oncall: incident remains open until RCA + patch plan. tagging: kernel, quant, runtime, ops.

 tom-runtime: next steps: priya to lead RCA and coordinate with kernel vendor for patch or revert of fused-kernel tile alignment; yuki to add canary matrix that includes T4/CUDA520/int8-fused path in future rollouts; ops to add an automated prompt-level regression test (sample summarization prompts) that runs on every canary matrix. i'll draft blameless summary.

 priya-ml: started bisect on fused-kernel commits; suspect commit d12f4a2 that changed tile math for 8-byte alignment. pinged vendor with traces and sample failure cases. aiming for a vendor patch within 72 hours or we will implement internal guard to disable fused path for T4.

 yuki-ops: also adding router rule so that for 24h summarization routes in ap-sg we prefer fp16 nodes where available; will monitor cost impact.

 rachel-support: updated Brightline with rollback confirmation, provided incident link and timeline for permanent fix. they thanked the team and asked for a follow-up postmortem. :thumbsup:

 sre-oncall: will collect metrics and prepare timeline for postmortem; leave channel open for vendor responses.

 tom-runtime: thanks all. closing loop: please add follow-up tasks to the incident doc and tag owners. we'll reconvene after vendor reply or internal patch.
